0022600151.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-4, 14th in the East) host the Cleveland Cavaliers (3-1, 2nd in the Central, 0.5 games back) in the Bucks' 6th game of the season, with Milwaukee coming off a loss and sitting at 1-2 at home. Cleveland has won three straight and is 3-0 at home, and Meleek Thomas is out with a foot injury. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Bucks lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 123-116 loss in Milwaukee on March 17, 2026.
